protein_id.description: The accession/protein identifier from the input JSON.

protein_name.description: Protein name as reported in the input record, or a cautious note if absent.

organism.description: Organism information reported in the input record, or a cautious note if absent.

source_status.description: Brief status of the record, such as reviewed/unreviewed, annotation score, source databases, and protein-existence evidence if present.

overall_profile_summary.description: Short readable summary of all major information available for the protein, without making a final annotation decision.

identity_summary.description: Summary of accession, names, gene names, organism, and record metadata present in the input.

reported_function_summary.description: Summary of any function descriptions reported in the record, distinguishing curated/literature claims from predictions or absence of evidence.

go_annotation_summary.description: Summary of GO molecular function, biological process, and cellular component information present in the record.

enzyme_and_reaction_summary.description: Summary of EC numbers, catalytic activities, reactions, Rhea/CHEBI references, and enzyme predictions present in the record.

domain_family_and_feature_summary.description: Summary of Pfam/InterPro/COG/KOG/TIGRFAM/SMART/domain/family/sequence-feature information present in the record.

pathway_and_context_summary.description: Summary of pathway, KEGG, STRING, network, or contextual information present in the record.

tool_prediction_summary.description: Summary of outputs from computational tools such as eggNOG, reCOGnizer, DeepGO2, DeepFRI, CLEAN, InterPro, or similar tools when present.

strong_or_curated_information.description: Information supported by reviewed records, curated database entries, experimental/literature evidence, or strong multi-source agreement.

weak_predicted_or_indirect_information.description: Information that is automatic, ML-derived, homology-only, low-confidence, generic, or contextual.

conflicting_or_inconsistent_information.description: Any conflicting names, functions, EC numbers, GO terms, domains, localization hints, or tool disagreements; use an empty array if none are evident.

missing_or_limited_information.description: Important missing, sparse, unlabeled, generic, or unclear information in the input record.

review_notes.description: Short notes for a human reviewer about what to inspect, verify, or be careful with.
